run_video_captioning: run the video captioning pipeline to generate optimized captions for MSR-VTT videos using LLM and CLIP
optimize_video_captions: optimize video captions by iteratively generating and scoring descriptions against video features using a CLIP model
extract_video_features: extract video features from MP4 files by reading frames and encoding them with a CLIP model
extract_text_features: extract text features from a list of sentences using a CLIP model and tokenizer for zero-shot classification
configure_captioning_args: configure the video captioning pipeline arguments including model paths, batch sizes, and optimization iterations
